{{Quote|How do you plan on getting Grievous aboard your ship?''"<br />"''Not to worry, the good General and I have a ''history''. I'm sure he'll want to even the score, face to face.|Adi Gallia and Obi-Wan Kenobi, the latter electing to capture General Grievous aboard an ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser. |<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
The '''''Arquitens''-class light cruiser''', known more commonly as the '''Republic light cruiser''' or the '''Jedi light cruiser''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The enemy ships are faster and more maneuverable. I suggest caution.|TV-94, referring to the ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser and its companion ''Consular''-class cruisers|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
[[File:ArquitensBridge-GI.png|thumb|left|250px|The bridge of an ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]]
The ''Arquitens''-class resembled a smaller version of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], with engines similar to the smaller [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruiser]]. A [[Docking ring/Legends|docking ring]] was located on each side of the ship and a deep split cleaved the bow into two prongs.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Atop the main [[Hull/Legends|hull]] was a small T-shaped command tower, with two quad laser turrets flanking it. Two identical emplacements were located on the ventral bow, while four dual-barreled turbolaser batteries were located on the sides of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Large slits on either side of these cannons allowed them to be repositioned for frontal, broadside or backwards firing.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref> This function, combined with the dorsal & ventral turrets, granted the ship a good arc of fire.

All gun emplacements were retracted into the hull during re-entry to prevent the barrels from being damaged by sudden drag force.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> The bridge/bow turrets descended/ascended into large trap-door hatches, while the flank cannons receded into the bow prongs.

The ship also had two pairs of [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile tubes]] on the edges between its turbolaser cannons.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Like the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|refitted ''Consular''-class cruisers]], ships of this kind were regarded as "escort-class" by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], contrasting the ''Venator''-class which was identified as "cruiser-class."<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==Role==
{{Quote|Uh, sir, there are several ships coming out of hyperspace.''"<br />"''Are they Republic or Separatist?''"<br />"''Republic. Three cruiser-class, four escort-class.|A B1 battle droid reports to Grievous the arrival of Star Destroyers and four escort ships, including the ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
The ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser was often used as an escort for larger ships.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==History==
{{Quote|Get back to the bridge. We need to detach before Grievous jumps ship.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to the clone naval officers aboard his ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser during the Battle of Saleucami|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
[[File:CoburnAtTheHelm-EFK.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Coburn commands an ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser at Kadavo.]]
[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] commanded one of these ships during the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]], during which it was used to attract [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] as a distraction for the boarding party. The ship was destroyed during the battle, along with two [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] who were trying to pull away from the Separatist cruiser that had docked onto it.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Several ''Arquitens''-class light cruisers formed part of the fleet that protected [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] when it was [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attacked]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> ''Arquitens''-class ships were also part of the fleet that [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|engaged]] Ventress's fleet in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] later on.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Downhill Time">"[[Downhill]]" is set after "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" ([[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]), as "''[[Mandalorian Memories]]''" serves as a prequel to the episode. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] are published in chronological order, it can be concluded that "''Downhill''" takes place in 20 BBY.</ref> Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]] [[Thill]] took an Arquitens and sacrificed it during a [[Mission to Felucia (Skywalker and Kenobi)|mission to Felucia]], using the debris as a cover to infiltrate a [[Felucia Separatist base]] using a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]]. The mission ended with the base destroyed and the Jedi rescuing a group of orphaned children.<ref name="Downhill">{{TCWComicCite|6.43|Downhill}}</ref>

Following a distress call from the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists of the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] deployed a group containing ''Arquitens''-class light cruisers and a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] to investigate.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>

An ''Arquitens''-class also fought in the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]] late in the war.<ref name="TCW:Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This episode is filled with numerous new starship models, including the Separatist destroyer (based on a ship design seen in Episode III), a Republic light cruiser (a new design) and a Jedi ambassadorial shuttle (based on Joe Johnston concept art for the Imperial shuttle seen in Episode VI).|Episode Guide for "Grievous Intrigue"|<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode209.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>}}
[[File:Repligcru.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Final design for the ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser in "Grievous Intrigue"]]
The ''Arquitens''-class light cruiser first appeared in "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," though it did not receive a specific starship class until the publication of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''. ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.10|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.10]]''{{'s}} section on "Grievous Intrigue" incorrectly stated that Kenobi dueled General Grievous aboard the latter's flagship instead of Kenobi's light cruiser.
